official_sources.name: HM Land Registry title plan PG40s5

direct_official_checks: the title plan is one of three elements of a registered title
the register is another element of a registered title
documents referred to in the register may also form part of the title context
the title plan must be viewed with the register
title-plan geometry alone is not treated as exact legal boundary evidence
register context is required before precision escalation
candidate evidence stores title-plan and register-context roles separately
quality_effect: Prevents a title-plan-only inference from being promoted into exact legal boundary evidence.
